# ExamplePay Disputes

## Opening a dispute

A buyer can open a dispute in the ExamplePay resolution centre within 90 days of the payment date.
Disputes cover items that never arrived and items that differ significantly from the description.

## Steps

1. Open the resolution centre.
2. Choose the transaction.

3. Describe the problem and submit.

## Timeline table

| Stage | Days |
| --- | --- |
| Seller reply | 10 |
| Escalation window | 20 |
